about: Christmas in Color at Water World is a drive-through light show north of Denver.
It is set in the Water World lots at 8800 N Pecos St in Federal Heights.
Visit Denver lists nightly runs from November 20 to December 30, 2026.
Hours on that listing are 7 to 9 PM.
The show uses millions of lights timed to holiday music.
Guests tune the car radio and stay in the vehicle the whole time.
One ticket covers one vehicle, so the price is per car rather than per child.
The Classic Pass starts at $34.99 and prices vary by date.
The Family Pass at $49.99 adds an LED party pack.
The VIP Pass at $59.99 adds priority entry.
The drive takes roughly 30 minutes and passes festive tunnels.
Ticket transfers and exchanges are free.
faq: When is Christmas in Color at Water World in 2026?
Nightly from November 20 to December 30, 7 to 9 PM, per the Visit Denver listing.
How much does it cost?
The Classic Pass starts at $34.99 per vehicle, and prices vary by date.
Is it per person?
No, one ticket covers one vehicle.
How long is the drive?
About 30 minutes.
Where is it?
8800 N Pecos St, Federal Heights, CO 80260.
Can I change my date?
Yes, exchanges and transfers are free.
Do I need to get out of the car?
No, the show is designed to be watched from your vehicle.

about: Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre in Morrison is the setting for this stop of the Christmas in Color tour.
Cars use Entrance 1 on West Alameda Parkway.
Red Rocks says the lights are back on November 27, 2026.
Visit Denver's calendar lists 7 to 9 PM evenings through December 30.
Seats are not sold, since admission is by vehicle.
Classic admission starts at $34.99 and Family admission at $49.99.
The Family bundle includes a keepsake bag, two LED light sticks, two bulb necklaces and 3D glasses.
A Season Pass costs $89 and lets one vehicle come back as often as it likes.
Radio music is matched to the flashing bulbs along the route.
Plan on about half an hour from entry to exit.
Checkout offers an optional donation to Children's Hospital Colorado.
Sales are final, though date changes carry no fee.
faq: When does Christmas in Color open at Red Rocks?
Red Rocks lists November 27, 2026 as the start, and Visit Denver shows 7 to 9 PM evenings through December 30.
Where do I enter?
Entrance 1 at 18300 W Alameda Pkwy, Morrison, CO 80465.
What does the Family Pass add?
A keepsake bag with LED light sticks, bulb necklaces and 3D glasses.
Can I come more than once?
Yes, the $89 Season Pass covers unlimited visits for one vehicle.
How long does the loop take?
Roughly 30 minutes.
Is a ticket for each person?
No, a ticket covers the whole vehicle.
Is there a way to give back?
Checkout has an optional donation to Children's Hospital Colorado.

A Season Pass is $89 per vehicle.
Christmas glasses come with every car.
